# payment_batch_items

Payment batch items records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="payment_batch_items", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="payment_batch_items", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters:** exact scalar equality; in, contains, gte and lte operator objects on supported top-level fields. See DB-query-syntax for type and null behavior.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

## Fields

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string | Top-level filter | Account id: opaque identifier reference. Its target depends on the containing record/operation; do not infer a collection merely by pluralizing the field name. Explicit joins are listed separately. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Amount in integer minor currency units. Whether it denotes an instruction, liability or posted movement depends on this record type. |
| `bank_reference` | string | Top-level filter | Bank reference: commercial reference, which may differ from the storage id. Match using the documented reference field and business context. |
| `bank_version` | integer | Top-level filter | Bank version: version of the named evidence/object. Check applicability and status along with its version. |
| `batch_reference` | string | Top-level filter | Batch reference: commercial reference, which may differ from the storage id. Match using the documented reference field and business context. |
| `business_area` | string | Top-level filter | Business area: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `commercial_reference` | string | Top-level filter | Reference supplied by a commercial source; use the source and period when matching evidence. |
| `currency` | string | Top-level filter | Currency code for the associated monetary fields. Preserve separate currency balances. Public values represented here: `USD`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `name` | string | Top-level filter | Human-readable name. Names need not be unique; exact filters are case-sensitive. |
| `recipient_verified` | boolean | Top-level filter | Recipient verified: true/false state flag for this record. |
| `reference` | string | Top-level filter | Business reference on this object; its uniqueness depends on the issuer, entity and period. |
| `scope` | string | Top-level filter | Access namespace for the record. It is not a customer name or a universal case_id. |
| `settlement_delay` | integer | Top-level filter | Settlement delay: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `status` | string | Top-level filter | Current state of this particular object. A proposal or submission state is distinct from a posted payment or completed review. Public values represented here: `DUE`, `VOID`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `supplier_name` | string | Top-level filter | Supplier name: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
